summary: Source Description (SDES) items are normally sent in RTCP, but sometimes they need to arrive faster, for example when a new source joins an RTP session and receivers need to know who it is. This proposed standard defines an RTP header extension that carries SDES items in the media packets themselves, speeding up delivery.

eli5.summary: When a new person joins a video call, others want to know who it is straight away. Instead of waiting for a slow announcement, the name tag is attached directly to the first things they send.

questions: how to send rtcp sdes items faster
